findings.claim: backlog.md's IMP-631 entry (delivered in this same diff) tells the reader the model-map drift is unresolved, 'mimo rozsah' (out of scope) and that the nightly check is currently RED — but the code in this very diff already closes the drift (adds wan-source-checker to the map and splits it out of the escalator roster), so the check is expected to pass and the PM 'out of scope' framing no longer matches reality.
findings.fix: Update or retire the IMP-631 backlog entry to reflect that the drift was closed in this same range (map now carries wan-source-checker and OCR_MODEL_ROSTER excludes it via _MIMO_NABIDKU_ESKALATORU), instead of leaving a stale 'PM decided out of scope, check stays red' record that will mislead whoever reads the backlog next.
